title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0170e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.027178
  m_eff = 2.3651e-1 eV
  T_vev = 4.3255e-1 m⁻²
  ω = 0.3217 s⁻¹
  k = 0.2250 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.699504 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -9.887e-3
  J_spin = -3.307e-5
